edges.notes: OpenGL ES is the embedded/mobile profile within the broader Khronos OpenGL family (shared specification culture).
WebGL 1.0/2.0 normatively tracks OpenGL ES 2.0/3.0-class API baselines (Khronos WebGL materials).
Typical GLES drivers and EGL stacks on Linux-based mobile and embedded hosts.
Overlapping mobile/embedded GPU API space; Vulkan adoption competes with GLES on newer platforms.
